name: manual_f1ab78
claim: Before wiring P5/P6/P13 security patterns into production, require a concrete witness/topology premise check against the current deployment; if there are no independent witnesses and no adversarial incidents, descope Byzantine/Sybil machinery to simpler liveness controls until the trust boundary changes.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-12 STM next-increment gate: MULTIAGENT-SWARM-SECURITY-ANALYSIS.md addendum found current PT deployment is Mac+Win under one operator, with zero independent witnesses and only operational-flakiness incidents. The correct next step was to descope P5/P6/P13 wiring while keeping P9/P18/P2 fixes.
